# Move Workstation's scripted gestures into optional tour drivers

## Context

Source/caller inventory refreshed at dev `a57ffbe717` after the preview-owner extraction: Workspace is 4,478 total physical lines. `executeCrossZoneShowcaseStep` (352 method lines), `executeCrossWindowDockStep` (236), `executeStackReturnStep` (236) and `executeTearOutStep` (284) total 1,108 lines of scripted execution before their cursor, wait/cancel and receipt helpers.

Direct production dispatch is `executeCue` → `executeCrossZoneShowcaseStep`. Direct Neural Link callers are in `WorkstationFiveBeatNL` (all four executors) and `WorkstationTearOutSourceContinuityNL` (tear-out); unit callers cover cursor retirement and cross-zone dwell. The preview-symmetry witness now uses the engine header pop-out and has no executor call to retarget. Scenario/playback dispatch remains in scope where it reaches these owners indirectly.

The cross-zone executor reads dock truth, references, drag affordances and refresh completion. Native executors additionally borrow popup state, pane cache, participation, vessel/tear-out handlers and transfer receipts. These are current read/call dependencies to disposition during extraction, not a license to move native ownership into a tour driver. The vessel-policy leaf owns that separate cut.

This is a leaf of the dedicated Workstation consumer-refactoring epic. The shared outcome is a ≤1,000-total-line composition entrypoint with working ordinary docking and optional scripted demos.

Test-side coupling observed during #18459: a preview-only witness stopped in optional `executeTearOutStep` setup with `detachItem commit did not reach committed document truth`, including against untouched application source `9ce8ca7060` in headless mode with current-region assertions. Using the existing engine header pop-out plus direct Group ownership checks let all 16 preview frames execute successfully. This supports separating ordinary consumers and tests from demo drivers; it adds no repair or API-design AC to this leaf. The [baseline failure and evidence boundaries](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5582215885) remain on #17844.

## The Problem

The named responsibility currently lives on `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`, coupling its state, caller surface and teardown to the root. This leaf removes that responsibility and updates its actual callers in the same PR; it does not create a forwarding method for every moved member.

## The Architectural Reality

Placement pre-flight: the existing apps/workstation/tour domain already owns denseWorkstation.mjs and fiveBeatFilm.mjs. These are data siblings, not lifecycle-class precedent; use core.Base and the existing src/ai/client/TourRunner as the lifecycle precedent, with app-specific drivers kept beside their scenarios. The architecture map and ADR 0029 keep scripted product orchestration app-side and pointer mechanics engine-side. No new top-level subsystem or engine-map row is needed. Tests remain in the existing Workstation homes.

## The Fix

Move the four executors and their exclusively-owned helpers/state into registered app-side tour driver classes, grouped by in-window and native/cross-window journey responsibility. Keep interaction dispatch on the existing InteractionService. Update executeCue/playback calls and all unit/Neural-Link witnesses to target the driver owner directly. A small optional driver reference may remain on the workspace until the playback-owner leaf adopts it; old executor façade methods must not remain. Cursor cleanup and cancellation belong to the executing driver.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gesture executors and receipts | Current Workspace executor bodies and their existing workstation witnesses | Same scripted behavior and result semantics on a registered driver owner | Failed/cancelled gestures retain current recovery | Owner JSDoc and caller updates | Existing real gesture witnesses with updated owner targeting |
| Driver lifetime | Workspace cursor/wait/cancel helpers; core.Base; InteractionService | Creator owns drivers and pending work; disposal cancels/cleans without orphan input or cursors | Existing recovery on failure | Explicit ownership JSDoc | Unit disposal plus existing native/cancel journeys |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The four executor implementations, their exclusively-owned state and helper bodies leave Workspace; their callers target the new owners without one wrapper per removed method.
- [ ] Every new driver is a registered Neo class with executed methods on its prototype and an explicit bounded dependency surface. Each new module stays below 2,000 total source lines; record the Workspace entrypoint's before/after total physical line count and each moved owner's count in the PR, alongside the responsibility removal.
- [ ] Normal workspace use does not create a gesture driver until a scripted gesture is requested; importing a data-only initial layout does not start a driver.
- [ ] Existing named Workstation gesture and film-mode witnesses retain their semantic/geometry/identity assertions after their call targets move. Run only the selected existing journeys relevant to moved paths, with exact-head receipts.
- [ ] Cancellation, thrown/rejected step failure and workspace/driver destruction leave no live pointer, cursor or pending-work ownership behind.

## Out of Scope

TourRunner redesign, tour content changes, new native or Group semantics, moving actual user-drag policy into the demo driver, and whole-film acceptance closure.

## Avoided Traps

No giant helper or copied post-setup factory descriptors; no shadow Group/document registry; no feature removal or weakened assertions to meet the size bar. Preserve explicit creator/borrower cleanup. Existing defects require baseline attribution rather than a false green.

## Decision Record impact

Aligned with ADR 0029; preserves existing engine operation, Group, projection and native-window contracts. Any required engine-contract change must be separately authorized and linked before this leaf merges.
